tooltip.guidedrailways.bogie: Aim at straight or curved Create track and use to place, or install beneath a physical body without rails\nSupply rotation at the top; wrench toggles brake; when off-rail, select the vehicle then use the wrench while aiming at track; sneak-wrench removes
tooltip.guidedrailways.coupler: Mount on carriage ends with heads facing each other, then use the coupling tool\nArticulating joint with limited draft travel; wrench rotates unlinked couplers, sneak-wrench removes
tooltip.guidedrailways.coupling_tool: Use on two couplers to connect; use the selected coupler again to cancel\nSneak-use to uncouple
